definitions.explanation: Describes a person or lifestyle characterized by vigorous activity and energy. Used for people who are always doing things, as well as for lively or dynamic situations.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}はとても{活動的|かつどうてき}な{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: She is a very active person.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{八十歳|はちじゅっさい}を{過|す}ぎても{活動的|かつどうてき}に{暮|く}らしている。
examples.english: My grandfather lives actively even past the age of eighty.

examples.japanese: {退職|たいしょく}してからのほうが{活動的|かつどうてき}になって、{毎日|まいにち}ジムに{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: He's become more active since retiring, going to the gym every day.

notes:
USAGE:
A na-adjective formed from {活動|かつどう} (activity) + {的|てき} (suffix making na-adjectives). Used as a modifier with な ({活動的|かつどうてき}な{人|ひと}) or as a predicate with だ/です. The adverbial form {活動的|かつどうてき}に is also common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {活動的|かつどうてき}な{人|ひと} (an active person)
- {活動的|かつどうてき}な{生活|せいかつ} (an active lifestyle)
- {活動的|かつどうてき}に{過|す}ごす (to spend time actively)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {積極的|せっきょくてき}: proactive, assertive — emphasizes willingness to take initiative
- {元気|げんき}: energetic, healthy — more casual and broader in meaning
